major_cooldowns.name: Stormkeeper
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown and dump the charged casts into Lightning Bolt on one target or Chain Lightning in AoE, syncing it with Ascendance whenever both are close to ready.

major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it roughly on cooldown but always after Stormkeeper, and get your extra overload sources out before you enter the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 114050 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses; the self aura the log records is 1219480. 114051 and 114052 share the name and are unplayed variants.

major_cooldowns.name: Ancestral Swiftness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it roughly on cooldown right after Stormkeeper to spawn another Ancestor, then follow with Ascendance.

major_cooldowns.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Save it for movement you cannot pre-plan and keep hardcasting through it instead of dropping globals.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a telegraphed hit or a heavy damage phase, not after the damage lands.
defensives.id_note: 108271 is the cast seen in 3/5 parses; 292158 shares the name at a 90s cooldown and 8s duration and was not observed.

defensives.name: Stone Bulwark Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it ahead of incoming damage for a large absorb that keeps refilling while the totem lives.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Ancestral Guidance
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a burst window so your damage converts into healing on you and your group.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Spirit Link Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group for a raid hit that lands unevenly so health is shared and reduced.
defensives.id_note: 98008 is the castable id; 325174 shares the name and is the aura seen on players.

defensives.name: Healing Stream Totem
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it during rot damage so it ticks on you and nearby allies while you keep casting.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; 426214 shares the name.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Summon it when you need a body to soak damage or pull a loose add off you.

rules.description: Open Stormkeeper into Lava Burst then Ascendance
rules.action: Press Stormkeeper first, weave a Lava Burst, then send Ascendance.
Fire Stormkeeper first so Ascendance amplifies its extra overloads.

rules.description: Keep Flame Shock rolling on the boss
rules.action: Reapply Flame Shock before it expires so Lava Burst keeps its guaranteed crit.

rules.description: Refresh Flame Shock late, never clip it
rules.action: Wait until Flame Shock is inside its last 30% before you refresh it.

rules.description: Chain Lightning replaces Lightning Bolt in AoE
rules.action: Switch your filler to Chain Lightning as soon as the extra targets are up.

rules.description: Lightning Bolt over Lava Burst in Master of the Elements
rules.action: Spend Master of the Elements on Lightning Bolt or a spender and save Lava Burst for when it is down.

rules.description: Do not cast Lava Burst near the Maelstrom cap
rules.action: Dump Maelstrom into Elemental Blast or Earth Shock first when you are close to capping.

rules.description: Skyfury up for the whole pull
rules.action: Cast Skyfury before the pull and rebuff it after any wipe or reset.

source_summary: Elemental stacks its cooldowns: Stormkeeper goes out on cooldown and Ascendance follows it so the buffed overloads land inside the window, with Ancestral Swiftness pressed alongside for another Ancestor. Between windows you keep Flame Shock rolling, spend Master of the Elements on Elemental Blast, Earth Shock or Lightning Bolt rather than on Lava Burst, and never let Maelstrom cap. Chain Lightning takes over from Lightning Bolt as the AoE filler, with Earthquake as the spender once the pack is large.
